verdict.rationale: Apify's docs explicitly state a feature to 'Check the performance of your Actors, validate data quality, and receive alerts' (apify-docs-7), and webhooks can trigger notifications or downstream actions when an Actor run finishes or fails (apify-docs-14), supported by log streaming and error-handling in the API clients (apify-docs-18, apify-docs-19). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the monitoring dashboard and alerting reliability, and more detail on what 'data quality validation' concretely covers.
